@kt.kernel
def k(x=kt.In(64, 32), y=kt.Out(64, 32)):
    h = kt.buffer((64, 32), "f16")
    kt.copy(h, x)
    kt.copy(y, h)


def facts():
    c = K.specialise(k, {"x": kt.TensorSpec.make((64, 32))}, machine=DEV.machine)
    body = c.l1.body(c.name, "l1")
    scratch = [p for p, _ in body.params if p not in ("x", "y")]
    xs, ys = ST.Storage(DEV, 4096), ST.Storage(DEV, 4096)
    used = DEV.dram.used
    DEV.run(c, {"x": xs.addr, "y": ys.addr})
    freed = DEV.dram.used == used
    xs.free()
    ys.free()
    return {"scratch": len(scratch) > 0, "freed": freed}
